post.originalText:
This is freaking crazy! 🤯  I told Opus 5.5 to create the 1984 Apple Ad and make it for itself! 

It produced this masterpiece only from code! 🔥

The amount of detail it went to make this is insane, it even checked the sound decibel levels to ensure it's exactly how it planned! 

Prompt: "create a 30 second ad for Opus 5.5 inspired by Apple 1984 ad, iykyk! avoid the border text or frames!"
